what: Parent in-kernel exact GF(2) control of the f195 rank-8 Gram step: among all six-sets of F2^d containing zero with zero XOR, none has Gram G=sum_z w_z w_z^T equal to zero; d=3 has no such six-set at all (0 sets), d=4 has168 such six-sets and0 with zero Gram. limits: In-kernel Python, no standalone script hash/exit receipt; finite control of one linear-algebra step, not of the universal theorem; not a replay of the author exhaustive search.
